prompt: We self-host Flowise in Docker with the default SQLite setup. It was fine for one person but now three of us use it and it locks up, and we lost some flows last week after a container restart. We're also about to put it behind our SSO. What do we need to change before this becomes a real internal tool?
assertions: Identifies SQLite as the cause of the locking under concurrent use and recommends Postgres
Names specific DATABASE_* environment variables rather than describing them vaguely
Explains the lost-flows cause as unpersisted volume / default data path, with the fix
Warns that the credential encryption key must be stable (FLOWISE_SECRETKEY_OVERWRITE)
States that SSO is an enterprise-licensed feature, not available on the open-source build
Tells the user the project is archived and which version to pin
